item.airstrike.strike_designator.hint.fi: LMB while scoped — launch, wheel — weapon
airstrike.weapon.drone.desc: Kamikaze drone: moped buzz, dive, blast
airstrike.weapon.missile.desc: Cruise missile: terrain hugging, pop-up, whistle, heavy blast
airstrike.weapon.rocket.desc: Multiple rocket launcher like the Grad: 40 tubes, ballistic rockets, a ripple that blankets an area
airstrike.weapon.loiter.desc: Loitering munition like the Lancet: circles over the target, pick a target from its camera (%s), dive
airstrike.weapon.bunker.desc: B-2 and bunker buster: penetrates the ground, blast underground
airstrike.target.locked: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike will follow it
airstrike.target.unseen: %s is not spotted: players and aircraft can be struck only while you see them — through binoculars or your projectile's camera — or your team has seen them
airstrike.target.last_seen: ⌖ Target: where %s was seen %s s ago
airstrike.target.locked.camera: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike follows it while you keep it in the camera frame (%s); otherwise it goes where it was last seen
airstrike.target.locked.point: ⌖ Target: %s — the strike hits where it was seen: only the Shahed and the Lancet follow a target, by camera
airstrike.launch.no_site: No room for a launcher: buildings block the launch path. Coming in from afar.
airstrike.launch.no_site.ordered: No room for a launcher at the launch point: rounds start from there without one.
airstrike.launched.drone: Shahed leaving the launcher. Impact in ~%s s: follow it with the camera (%2$s).
airstrike.launched.missile: Cruise missile launched. Impact in ~%s s.
airstrike.launched.rocket: MLRS: rocket away. Impact in ~%s s.
airstrike.launched.loiter: Loitering munition: catapult launch. Impact in ~%s s: pick the target from its camera (%2$s, LMB).
airstrike.launched.bunker: B-2 scrambled and heading for the attack run. Release in ~%s s.
airstrike.launch_failed: Launch failed: the world near the target is not loaded
airstrike.too_many_active: Too many strikes in progress (%s, limit %s): wait for them to land or give the all-clear
airstrike.munitions.short.rounds: Not enough rockets: %s — need %s, have %s (%s per pack)
airstrike.munitions.refunded.dead: You died — the returned munitions lie where you fell
airstrike.salvo.started.drone: ✈ Shahed salvo: %s drones, spread %s. First one in ~5 s.
airstrike.salvo.started.missile: ➶ Cruise missile salvo: %s missiles, spread %s. First one in ~7 s.
airstrike.salvo.started.bunker: ✹ B-2 raid: %s bombs, spread %s. First run in ~3 s.
airstrike.salvo.started.rocket: ☄ MLRS salvo: %s rockets, spread %s blocks. Ripple every half second.
airstrike.salvo.started.loiter: ✈ Loitering swarm: %s munitions, spread %s. They circle over the target and dive one by one.
airstrike.cleared: All drones, missiles, bombs, salvos and nuclear strikes cancelled (total: %s). Destroyed blocks are not restored.
airstrike.cleared.conventional: Drones, missiles, bombs and salvos cancelled (total: %s); nuclear strikes are not affected. Destroyed blocks are not restored.
airstrike.recalled: Your strikes stood down: %s projectiles stopped, %s salvos cancelled. A nuclear strike can't be recalled; Grad rockets and a dropped bomb still land.
airstrike.no_permission: The designator is for operators only (designator_for_everyone setting)
airstrike.route.out_of_range: Route point too far: up to %s blocks from you
airstrike.route.too_long: %s cannot fly this route: %s km, range %s km
airstrike.route.outside_world: Point %s %s is outside the world border
airstrike.hud.scope_hint: LMB — launch · wheel — weapon · Shift+RMB — console
airstrike.remote.title: ☢ STRIKE CONSOLE
airstrike.remote.clear.tooltip: Call off your strikes: projectiles self-destruct in the air, the B-2 turns away, salvos are cancelled
airstrike.remote.hint.look: Centre — the point you are looking at
airstrike.remote.hint.player.camera: The strike goes where the player was seen and follows them while you keep them in the camera frame (%s)
airstrike.remote.hint.player.point: The strike goes where the player was seen
airstrike.remote.hint.no_players: Nobody spotted: players appear here when you or your team see them
airstrike.remote.hint.aircraft.camera: The strike goes where the aircraft was seen and follows it while you keep it in the camera frame (%s)
airstrike.remote.hint.aircraft.point: The strike goes where the aircraft was seen
airstrike.remote.hint.no_map: Pick a location on the map
airstrike.remote.hint.map_route: Target: map location X %s, Z %s · route: %s points
airstrike.help.title: ━━━━━━  ☢ AIRSTRIKE  ━━━━━━
airstrike.help.1: Strike Designator: RMB — binoculars, LMB — launch, wheel — weapon, Shift+RMB — console
airstrike.help.3: /airstrike missile <player or mob> — at the target; a player must be in sight (server operators: no rules)
airstrike.help.4: /airstrike bunker at <x y z> — at a point; the bomb digs down to a target in a cave
airstrike.help.6: /airstrike menu — console, /airstrike clear — stand down your strikes (an operator or the host: all strikes), /airstrike give — designator
airstrike.help.7: Settings: Mods → Airstrike → Config (power, glass, fires, siren, shake)
airstrike.help.8: Sound follows the Ambient slider; shake and flash are client settings
airstrike.help.9: Create Aeronautics aircraft are targets too: aim the binoculars or pick one in the console
death.attack.airstrike.strike.player: %1$s died in an airstrike while fighting %2$s
death.attack.airstrike.strike.item: %1$s died in an airstrike called by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.airstrike.shockwave: %1$s was killed by an underground shockwave (%2$s)
death.attack.airstrike.shockwave.player: %1$s was killed by an underground shockwave while fighting %2$s
death.attack.airstrike.shockwave.item: %1$s was killed by an underground shockwave called by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.airstrike.kinetic: %1$s was crushed by a bunker buster (%2$s)
death.attack.airstrike.kinetic.player: %1$s was crushed by a bunker buster while fighting %2$s
death.attack.airstrike.kinetic.item: %1$s was crushed by a bunker buster dropped by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.airstrike.debris.player: %1$s was hit by debris while fighting %2$s
death.attack.airstrike.debris.item: %1$s was hit by debris from a strike by %2$s using %3$s
airstrike.configuration.title: Airstrike settings
airstrike.config.rocket_power.tooltip: Per rocket of the salvo. TNT = 4.
airstrike.config.max_active_per_player.t: 0 — unlimited. Counts projectiles in flight and salvo shots not yet fired; operators are not limited
airstrike.config.map_range.tooltip: The server loads the target area, and generates it where nobody has been: the larger the range, the more new world generation
airstrike.config.map_players.tooltip: Same dimension, within map range: teammates always, others where they were last seen. Off: the map does not draw them, the designator target list stays
airstrike.config.sight_rules.tooltip: The designator strikes another player or aircraft only if you or your team see it (or saw it recently, then at the last known place); the map shows others the same way
airstrike.config.sight_memory.tooltip: How many seconds a side remembers a spotted player or aircraft
airstrike.config.camera_shake.tooltip: 0 — off. Aim is never disturbed: only the camera shakes
item.airstrike.geiger_counter.tip: In hand: clicks and dose rate above the hotbar
item.airstrike.shahed.tip: Designator munition: one Shahed per launch
item.airstrike.lancet.tip: Designator munition: one Lancet per launch
item.airstrike.cruise_missile.tip: Designator munition: one missile per launch; with a nuclear warhead, a nuclear warhead as well
item.airstrike.grad_rockets.tip: Designator munition for the MLRS: 40 rockets, each launch uses one
item.airstrike.bunker_buster.tip: Designator munition: one bomb per B-2 run; with a nuclear warhead, a nuclear warhead as well
item.airstrike.icbm.tip: Designator munition: an intercontinental missile with a nuclear warhead, one per launch
item.airstrike.nuclear_warhead.tip: Fitted to a cruise missile or a B-2 bomb when the designator is set to a nuclear warhead
airstrike.weapon.nuke.desc: ICBM with a nuclear warhead: flash, fireball, mushroom cloud, blast wave, fallout
airstrike.launched.nuke: ☢ ICBM launched. Detonation on a timer: see the countdown at the top of the screen.
airstrike.nuke.disabled: Nuclear weapons are disabled in the server config
airstrike.nuke.ops_only: Nuclear strikes are for operators only (config nuclear.ops_only)
key.airstrike.second_key: Second key (confirm a nuclear launch nearby)
airstrike.config.nuke_second_key_distanc: A non-operator nuclear strike (ops_only off) needs another player within this many blocks to press «Second key». Alone online: no key needed.
No second key in time: no launch, munitions are returned.
airstrike.nuke.key.wait: ☢ %s: second key needed — another player within %s blocks of you presses %s within %s s
airstrike.nuke.key.prompt: ☢ %s asks for the second key: %s at %s, %s. Confirm with %s (%s s left)
airstrike.nuke.key.none: No nuclear launch within %s blocks is waiting for a second key
airstrike.nuke.key.expired: ☢ No second key for %s s — launch cancelled
airstrike.nuke.key.cancelled: ☢ A nuclear launch waiting for its second key or alarm was cancelled
airstrike.nuke.alarm.armed: ☢ Nuclear alarm raised at the target. Launch in %s s
airstrike.nuke.alarm.carrier: ☢ NUCLEAR ALARM: %s — strike on area %s, %s, launch in %s s
airstrike.nuke.launch_detected.carrier: ☢ Launch detected: %s with a nuclear warhead from area %s, %s
airstrike.nuke.no_retarget: A nuclear projectile can't be retargeted: the alarm and the second key were for its original target
airstrike.nuke.alert.eta: Impact in %s s: take cover, get underground
airstrike.nuke.countdown: ☢ ICBM in flight · %2$s kt · detonation in %1$s s
airstrike.nuke.delayed: ☢ Detonation delayed: the target area is still loading
airstrike.remote.burst.tooltip: Air: widest destruction, almost no fallout. Ground: crater, trinitite and a fallout trail with black rain
airstrike.radiation.report: %s: dose %s Gy, dose rate %s, contamination %s R/h
airstrike.help.10: /airstrike nuke [kt] [air|ground]: ICBM where you look; nuke at <x y z> …; nuke now …: detonate at once (operators only)
airstrike.help.11: /airstrike radiation [player]: dose; radiation clear [players]: remove exposure

death.attack.airstrike.nuclear_thermal.i: %1$s was burned by the light of a nuclear explosion set off by %2$s using %3$s

death.attack.airstrike.radiation.player: %1$s died of radiation sickness while fighting %2$s
death.attack.airstrike.radiation.item: %1$s died of radiation sickness after a strike by %2$s using %3$s

airstrike.config.nuke_effects_scale.tool: 1.0: true to life (1 block = 1 m). Lower for small worlds
airstrike.config.nuke_tree_fall: Trees fall away from ground zero
airstrike.config.nuke_time_budget.toolti: Limit for nuclear destruction within the total per-tick budget (mod work per tick). More is faster but may stutter
airstrike.config.nuke_prep_budget: Ruins pre-build budget per tick, ms
airstrike.config.nuke_prep_budget.toolti: Milliseconds of each tick spent on pre-building ruins while the ICBM flies, so blocks fall with the blast front
airstrike.config.nuke_far_zone: Generate the zone for far ruins
airstrike.config.nuke_far_zone.tooltip: With Distant Horizons: the heavy zone that is not on disk yet (edge of the explored world) is generated in the background behind the wave, so the ruins are visible from afar at once. Off: ruins appear there only when a player walks there
airstrike.config.nuke_ruin_threads.toolt: Background threads that build ruin plans from chunk snapshots and read far chunks from disk; 0 uses all cores but three (server, rendering, world I/O), and the mod lowers or raises how many work by server tick time
airstrike.config.map_prefetch.tooltip: While a designator is in the inventory or the map was opened — the map opens instantly
airstrike.nuke.detonating: ☢ %s kt detonation (%s) at %s %s %s as soon as the area loads
airstrike.map.video_at: Video within %s m of you (now %s m)
airstrike.map.title: Targeting map
airstrike.map.hint: LMB — strike location or player · drag — pan · wheel — zoom · space — to me
airstrike.map.selected_player_away: Target: %s — not in this dimension or not on the map yet · Enter — fire
airstrike.map.near_only: Terrain from loaded chunks only; Distant Horizons shows far terrain
airstrike.map.far_pending: Distant Horizons is still loading its own terrain; far terrain will appear when it answers
airstrike.map.no_ceiling: No map strikes in a world with a ceiling (the Nether): the map sees only the roof
airstrike.map.out_of_range: Too far: map strikes reach up to %s blocks
airstrike.map.route.hint: Route: Shift+LMB — add point (up to %s) · drag a point — move · RMB — remove
airstrike.map.route.no_target: Route: %s of %s points · pick a target (LMB)
airstrike.map.route.too_long: Route %s is beyond the weapon range (%s): remove or move points
airstrike.map.route.weapon: %s flies without a route; Shahed, Missile and Loitering fly by points
airstrike.map.route.unused: %s ignores the route and flies to the target itself
airstrike.camera.hint: LMB new target · %s next · Shift exit · F5 view
airstrike.camera.loiter: LOITERING · put the crosshair on a target and press LMB to strike
airstrike.camera.pursuit.waiting: TARGET OUT OF FRAME · HEADING TO LAST SEEN POINT
airstrike.remote.warhead.tooltip: Nuclear warhead on the cruise missile or the B-2 bomb: a single round, yield of your choice. The missile bursts over the target or at the ground, the bomb underground after drilling.
airstrike.config.launch_near_player: Launch from a launcher near the player
airstrike.config.launch_near_player.tool: Shaheds and missiles take off from a mobile launcher behind the player. Off: they come in from afar.
airstrike.config.drone_flight_time.toolt: Launch to impact: a detour route and the attack run. Never shorter than the direct path.
airstrike.config.missile_flight_time.too: Launch to impact, never shorter than the direct path.
airstrike.config.bomber_flight_time.tool: From the order to bomb release.
airstrike.config.loiter_time.tooltip: How long a loitering munition circles before diving (±20% per munition in a salvo). Pick a target from its camera to strike sooner.
airstrike.config.carrier_nukes: Nuclear warhead on missile and B-2
airstrike.config.carrier_nukes.tooltip: Allow a nuclear warhead on carriers other than the ICBM. Same permissions as the ICBM.
airstrike.config.auto_camera.tooltip: Every launch of yours is shown automatically: the launch from the side, the flight from on board, the impact. Shift exits.
airstrike.config.grid_enabled.tooltip: A strike on a substation cuts power to its area: electric lights go out district by district.
airstrike.config.grid_node_radius.toolti: Blocks powered by a placed substation.
airstrike.config.grid_max_radius.tooltip: Blocks. Nothing further goes dark, even after a nuke.
airstrike.config.grid_cascade_speed.tool: Blocks per second the outage spreads across districts.
airstrike.config.grid_restore_spread.too: Seconds over which districts get power back, in random order.
airstrike.config.grid_nuke: Nuke cuts power in its radius
airstrike.config.grid_time_budget.toolti: Limit for blackout lights within the total per-tick budget (mod work per tick).
airstrike.config.far_range: Far sight and hearing range, blocks
airstrike.config.far_range.tooltip: Beyond render distance players see and hear projectiles in flight and conventional blasts up to this range (haze still hides them by the weather)
airstrike.config.work_budget.tooltip: At most how many milliseconds of each server tick the mod spends on heavy work in total: strike destruction, then the nuke, then blackout lights. Only from the time left in the tick.
airstrike.help.12: /airstrike grid status|blackout|restore|node …: power grid status, cut power to an area, restore power, map nodes
airstrike.help.13: /airstrike salvo … [from x z] [via x z …] — launch point (operators) and route points, as on the map; a single round — salvo <weapon> 1 0 …
airstrike.help.14: /airstrike launcher <x y z> [fire|clear|load N|owner …|mission <weapon> N spread x y z [via …]] — fixed launcher (operators)
airstrike.grid.status: Outages: %s, grid nodes: %s (chunks queued %s, lamps to relight %s)
airstrike.grid.status_clock: Queue: %s units last tick (budget %s ms), next unit estimate %s ms, longest unit in 5–10 s %s ms
airstrike.grid.status_head: Chunk taken most times in a row: %s %s, %s times
airstrike.grid.status_reads: Chunk reads from disk not for the world (since start): on other threads %s, copies of loaded chunks %s
item.airstrike.interceptor.tip: For the SAM: right-click it, or feed with a hopper or a Create funnel
airstrike.config.sam_radar_range.tooltip: Stealthy targets (B-2, cruise missile, Lancet) are seen closer — per the weapon passport
airstrike.config.sam_engage_range.toolti: Shoots down hostile Shaheds, cruise missiles, Lancets and B-2s; not ICBMs or Grad rockets
airstrike.config.sam_kill_probability.to: 0–1: share of bursts near the target that bring it down as debris
airstrike.sam.alert_many: Air raid alert! Targets: %s, nearest — %s: %s, %s km
airstrike.sam.status: SAM: %s of %s on the rails, %s in stock; hostile targets %s, on radar %s
airstrike.sam.covered: SAM: something is blocking the launcher overhead — cannot fire
airstrike.fixed_launcher.no_mission: Launcher: no mission — link it to a designator (right-click it with one) and press Fire; rounds in stock: %s
airstrike.fixed_launcher.status: Launcher: %s ×%s at %s %s, spread %s; rounds in stock: %s
airstrike.fixed_launcher.linked: Launcher linked to the designator (%s total): Fire now gives the launchers a mission
airstrike.fixed_launcher.unlinked: Launcher unlinked from the designator (%s left)
airstrike.fixed_launcher.links_full: %s launchers are already linked to this designator
airstrike.fixed_launcher.on_craft: the launcher does not fire from an aircraft
airstrike.fixed_launcher.no_rights: the launcher's owner may not use the designator
airstrike.fixed_launcher.out_of_range: target is more than %s blocks from the launcher
airstrike.fixed_launcher.busy: the launcher is busy with the previous order
airstrike.fixed_launcher.no_nuke: The launcher does not take a nuclear warhead
airstrike.fixed_launcher.unsupported: The launcher cannot fire %s: only what starts from a rack (Shaheds, Lancets, cruise missiles, Grad)
airstrike.fixed_launcher.elsewhere: the launcher is in another dimension
airstrike.fixed_launcher.not_loaded: the launcher is far away, its area is not loaded
airstrike.fixed_launcher.gone: the launcher is gone and was unlinked
airstrike.fixed_launcher.none_here: There is no fixed launcher here
airstrike.fixed_launcher.owner: Launcher owner: %s — rounds fly in their name, under their rules
airstrike.fixed_launcher.owner.none: The launcher has no owner: no owner rules, like the console
item.airstrike.strike_designator.launche: Linked launchers: %s — Fire gives them a mission
item.airstrike.strike_designator.hint.li: RMB on a fixed launcher — link it
